findings.claim: The uncounted SizeSummary fragment is a clause but its three callers splice it where a noun phrase belongs, so legacy texts are ungrammatical
findings.evidence: SizeSummary returns 'production lines were not counted, N with tests (allocation M)'; intent_unit_questions.go:244 'has %s', :282 'grew to %s', intent_unit_review.go:90 'accept %s'
findings.change: Make the uncounted fragment a noun phrase, e.g. 'N changed lines with tests (allocation M; production lines not counted)'
findings.relation: new: one size fragment must read as a noun phrase in every caller

findings.claim: isBuildTestPath omits the -fixtures.sh suffix that isExistingTestPath includes
findings.evidence: internal/goal/branch/attest.go:232 has strings.HasSuffix(base, "-fixtures.sh"); isBuildTestPath does not; the brief's enumerated list also omits it
findings.change: Optionally add -fixtures.sh; over-counting only makes the hold stricter
findings.relation: new: the test-path list mirrors isExistingTestPath

findings.claim: A hold whose question was asked under the old wording gets a second open question at the next sync, since askOrFind matches on facts
findings.evidence: internal/channel/unit_stop.go askUnitStop -> askOrFind; reconcileUnitStopQuestions closes by subject/attempt/finding on an act; T7 deletes the old question before re-sync
findings.change: None required; one acceptance closes both; transitional
findings.relation: new: a changed unit-stop wording re-asks an open question

findings.claim: The ceiling parse error names neither the conf file nor a next act
findings.evidence: fmt.Errorf("design.unit-lines-max must be a positive integer, got %q", value); CommittedLookup error returned unwrapped
findings.change: Optionally name the committed conf path and the fix
findings.relation: new: refusals name their next act

findings.claim: The new reset check calls t.Fatal(err) when err may be nil, so a reset failure prints <nil>
findings.evidence: if err != nil || reset.Record.Rounds[0].ProductionLines != nil || ... { t.Fatal(err) }
findings.change: Report the round in the failure message
findings.relation: new: test failures say what failed
